summary: Compressing into a supplied buffer with a 1–3 byte dictionary can attempt a four-byte dictionary read, causing a bounds panic with default safe-encode features or an out-of-bounds read with unsafe encoding. The fix routes dictionaries shorter than MINMATCH through compression without a dictionary. Reverse the sink guard and its fallback helper together to restore the faulty path without leaving an unused function under deny(warnings). The selected test was added by this fix and checks dictionary lengths 0–3. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: range end index 4 out of range for slice of length 1
